purpose: adversarial audit of the OATH v0.11 clause and battery, run against the frozen prereg AFTER every gate passed

method.refutation: each finding faced 2 independent skeptics prompted to REFUTE, defaulting to refuted when the defect could not be independently exhibited
method.survival_rule: a finding survives only if NO skeptic refuted it
